# Repository guidance

Follow [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) for every job: boundaries, content locations, the required acceptance flow and commands.

- This is a fork. Always target `matthidinger/matthidinger.github.io`, never the upstream theme repository.
- New PRs target `master` and stay draft until readiness passes. Only Matt merges and publishes; never push to `master`, merge, or deploy.
- Never invent conferences, talks, dates, credits or URLs. Ask on the issue for missing required facts; omit optional ones.
